Card Q&A.a: No, it isn't affected by [Security] effects, either.
Card Q&A.q: My Digimon is affected by this card's "This Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards" effect. Is it affected by the [Security] effect of my opponent's Option cards?

Card Q&A.a: No, they can't. The "When this Digimon is suspended, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost less than or equal to this Digimon" effect from this card is a Digimon effect. It isn't considered to be an Option card effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can "isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards" effects prevent the "When this Digimon is suspended, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost less than or equal to this Digimon" effect given to an opponent's Digimon by this card?

Effect: [Main] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon gains "[Opponent's Turn] When this Digimon becomes suspended, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost less than or equal to this Digimon's" and "[Opponent's Turn] This Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's Option cards."
Security Effect: [Security] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest play cost.
